d: Struggling with a stubborn blank page in Microsoft Word, accidentally shouting in ALL CAPS, or closed an essential browser tab by mistake? In this episode of Tech It Out, we break down five essential keyboard shortcuts and desktop fixes that solve the most searched workplace tech problems: how to delete stubborn blank pages and page breaks in Word, how to convert uppercase text to lowercase using Shift + F3 without retyping, how to reopen accidentally closed browser tabs on Windows and Mac, how to share precise YouTube video timestamps, and how to instantly access hidden tick marks,…
